Alumni

Fiona Hsu

Class of 2025

Roles

  • President 2024-2025, Science Olympiad Captain 2023-2024, 2024-2025

Bio

Senior Fiona Hsu serves as this school year's Science Olympiad co-captain. Aside from competing in, of course, Science Olympiad competitions, she has also been in a few MUN conferences. Unfortunately, the entirety of her personality revolves around having moved from USA to Taiwan to USA, and thus she carries a bunch of unrelatable and strange credentials ranging from the ability to do balloon sculpting to doing front flips (no I will not demonstrate). She also runs. Which, in fact, is painful. This year, Fiona has also become a Co-President of the Academic Challenge Club. She has a special obsession with chemistry, because NaOH is yummy (just kidding, please do not consume NaOH). Overall, she has other interests outside of school, including creating foodstuffs, drawing, reading, surviving through typhoons in Taiwan, and gaming quite a bit.
